crossRefs.note: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold…
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
translations.bsb: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
translations.kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
translations.asv: Again on the morrow John was standing, and two of his disciples;
